nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the futures_chapter15 system package, the reference trading system from Rob Carver's Systematic Trading chapter 15.

nodes.name: futuresconfig.yaml
nodes.summary: Fixed-parameter backtest configuration for the chapter 15 futures system, defining trading rules (EWMAC, carry), forecast caps and weights, instrument weights, volatility target, and asset-class groupings.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-tuned YAML config with fixed forecast and instrument weights (no estimation), suitable for a deterministic backtest.

nodes.name: futuresestimateconfig.yaml
nodes.summary: Estimated-parameter variant of the chapter 15 futures config that enables forecast scalar, forecast weight, forecast diversification multiplier, and instrument weight estimation from data rather than fixed values.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets use_*_estimates flags to true so weights and scalars are fitted in-sample/out-of-sample instead of being hard-coded.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the rob_system package, Rob Carver's full production-style trading system.

nodes.name: config.yaml
nodes.summary: Large production configuration for the rob_system, defining the full trading-rule set, attenuation, volatility calculation, forecast scalars and caps, risk overlay, and extensive per-instrument forecast and instrument weight tables.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large (~7700 lines) YAML driven mostly by exhaustive per-instrument forecast_weights and instrument_weights blocks.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker that makes the rules directory an importable package of standalone trading-rule functions.

nodes.name: _TO_DELETE_OLD.py
nodes.summary: Deprecated collection of trading-rule functions (breakout, short/long bias, relative carry, cross-sectional mean reversion) flagged for deletion; functionality now split into dedicated rule modules.

nodes.name: breakout
nodes.summary: Breakout trading rule that scales price relative to its rolling max/min range over a lookback window and smooths the resulting forecast with an EWMA.

nodes.name: cross_sectional_mean_reversion
nodes.summary: Cross-sectional mean-reversion rule measuring an instrument's normalised-price outperformance versus its asset class over a horizon and smoothing the negative signal.

nodes.name: breakout.py
nodes.summary: Standalone breakout trading-rule module computing a smoothed forecast from where price sits within its rolling high/low range over a lookback period.

nodes.name: breakout
nodes.summary: Computes a breakout forecast by normalising price against its rolling max/min midpoint over a lookback window and smoothing the result with an EWMA.

nodes.name: cs_mr.py
nodes.summary: Cross-sectional mean-reversion trading-rule module that generates a contrarian forecast from an instrument's relative outperformance against its asset class.

nodes.name: cross_sectional_mean_reversion
nodes.summary: Generates a cross-sectional mean-reversion forecast from the smoothed, horizon-averaged outperformance of an instrument's normalised price relative to its asset-class average.

nodes.name: rel_mom.py
nodes.summary: Relative-momentum trading-rule module producing a forecast from an instrument's persistent outperformance versus its asset class over a horizon.

nodes.name: relative_momentum
nodes.summary: Computes a relative-momentum forecast from the EWMA-smoothed, horizon-shifted outperformance of an instrument's normalised price against its asset-class average.
